INTERVIEW: Tile Studio (made-up demo)
Founder: A. Example
Location: Nowhere
Note: This interview is invented for trying the coding page. It is not a real Starter Story interview.
Q: Who are you and what business did you start?
I make hand-painted ceramic tiles. Before this I spent eight years as a product designer at a kitchen fittings company, so I know how builders and designers choose materials.
Q: How did you come up with the idea?

I was trying to sell custom mugs at a weekend market, and they were not moving at all. Then a contractor picked up one of my test tiles from the back of the stall and asked if I could make two hundred for a restaurant job. I had not even thought of tiles as a product.

Because of my design work I knew restaurants struggle to find small-batch tiles that match their branding. Within a week I had dropped the mugs, quoted the job and booked a kiln at the community studio.
Q: How is the business doing now?
That first order paid for my own kiln. Restaurants are now most of our revenue, and the contractor still sends us work.
